title: The Name Thief
text: Someone in the city has stolen a Scion's name. They are wearing it in the market right now, answering to it, buying and laughing and signing debts with it, and people believe them. When the Scion says their own name aloud, it sounds wrong in their mouth.

options.label: The Scion with the strongest will confronts the thief and demands their name back.

outcomes.text: Their name is theirs again, and it fits.
The thief smiles with the Scion's mouth and keeps the name a while longer. It sounds better on them.

options.label: Buy the name back; better to pay than to argue over who you are.

outcomes.text: Names are cheap here, which should worry you more than it does.

options.label: The shrewdest steals the thief's own name in return, to see how they like it.

outcomes.text: It is a useful name to have. Nobody here will miss it, not even its owner, it seems.
